findings.name: SUBJECT_INGRESS_NOT_AUTHENTICATED_TO_OWNER_MATERIALIZATION_USE_CHAIN
findings.proof: S3 accepts any nonempty subject_ref, arbitrary nonempty owner id/version, any sha256-shaped owner/object hashes, and generic ExactRef values for materialization_receipt and causal_use_permission. The hostile court admitted AVAILABLE with free-form subject_ref and refs labeled COLOCATION/SAME_GEOGRAPHY_TIME.
findings.authority_conflict: ADP-010 BASIS_TO_AVAILABLE requires exact basis identity, authority/version/epistemic class, causal-use permission, actor/context/time, and provenance/integrity. R2 requires an already owner-bound exact subject plus exact materialization receipt.
findings.repair_grain: Authenticate one exact externally supplied subject ingress contract; verify subject_ref, owner identity/hash, semantic object identity, materialization receipt, causal-use permission and provenance are mutually content-addressed and resolve to the same object. Do not create or classify the subject.

findings.name: ADP008_PHASE_STATE_NOT_BOUND_TO_REPLAY_OR_RECORD_IDENTITY
findings.proof: Two different exact V3DevelopmentalPhaseState refs for the same actor and declared active base phase produce the same source_candidate_replay_hash, record_id and record_hash. The record body can therefore differ in phase_state_ref under one identity.
findings.authority_conflict: ADP-010 requires active phase and replay provenance; ADP-008 replay identity requires exact phase state/registry/rule provenance.
findings.repair_grain: Validate the exact ADP-008 phase-state record/receipt and bind its exact phase_state_ref/hash plus relevant accepted authority/registry identity into replay material.

findings.name: APPLICABILITY_AUTHORITY_SIGNATURE_NOT_BOUND
findings.proof: Changing PositiveApplicabilityReceipt authority_id, authority_version and authority_content_hash while keeping its receipt ref fixed leaves opportunity candidate replay hash and record identity unchanged.
findings.authority_conflict: ADP-010 required rule semantics include exact input authority signatures/use permissions and required positive applicability.
findings.repair_grain: Authenticate the applicability receipt against its owning accepted authority and bind exact authority/version/content hash and receipt identity into candidate replay material.

findings.name: CONTACT_WITNESS_AUTHORITY_AND_INDEPENDENCE_NOT_AUTHENTICATED
findings.proof: Changing contact witness authority_id/version/content_hash while keeping witness_ref fixed leaves ENCOUNTER identity unchanged. Any nonempty claimed authority passes. Independence is accepted by ref kind label only.
findings.authority_conflict: ADP-010 requires an exact contact witness independent of co-presence and exact input authority signatures/provenance.
findings.repair_grain: Require an independently competent contact-occurrence witness authority/receipt and cryptographically/content-addressedly bind authority, witness, independence proof, actor, subject, time, semantic and provenance.

findings.name: COLOCATION_CAN_BE_LAUNDERED_BY_RELABELING
findings.proof: The hostile court produced OEE_ENCOUNTER_OCCURRED where the only positive provenance refs were COLOCATION and SAME_GEOGRAPHY_TIME, by wrapping them in caller-created CONTACT_OCCURRENCE_WITNESS / CONTACT_WITNESS_INDEPENDENCE labels under an unaccepted arbitrary authority.
findings.authority_conflict: ADP-010 explicitly forbids co-location, co-presence, same geography/time and structural proximity as ENCOUNTER evidence by themselves.
findings.repair_grain: Do not trust caller labels. Validate the witness's owning authority and exact occurrence receipt independently of proximity evidence.

findings.name: VALIDATE_RECORD_DOES_NOT_RECOMPUTE_REPLAY_BINDINGS
findings.proof: Without changing record_id, record_hash or source_candidate_replay_hash, T3 changed source_candidate_id, context refs, applicability refs, phase_state_ref, constraint refs, prior ledger anchor and provenance refs; validate_record accepted the tampered record.
findings.authority_conflict: ADP-010 requires reconstructible replay/provenance, candidate identity, integrity, and malformed/tampered input fail-closed.
findings.repair_grain: Persist enough exact candidate material to recompute source_candidate_replay_hash and source_candidate_id, then validate all replay-committed fields against that recomputation. Fields not in record identity must still be transitively committed by validated candidate identity.

findings.name: REQUIRED_RULE_AUTHORITY_HASH_PROVENANCE_NOT_MECHANICALLY_REQUIRED
findings.proof: A valid AVAILABLE record is emitted with no exact ADP-010 authority/registry/rule hash provenance ref. The implementation only requires arbitrary nonempty provenance refs.
findings.authority_conflict: ADP-010 provenance minimum explicitly includes ADP-010 authority/registry/rule hashes and registry required semantics include rule hash.
findings.repair_grain: Require exact accepted ADP-010 authority/registry/rule content-address provenance at admission/replay validation. T3 does not invent a new rule hash convention.

findings.name: SOURCE_CANDIDATE_ID_NOT_DERIVED_OR_VALIDATED
findings.proof: source_candidate_id can be replaced with arbitrary text while record_id/hash remain unchanged and validate_record still passes.
findings.authority_conflict: V3OEERealizationRecord requires source candidate ID and replay hash; replay identity must be deterministic/content-addressed.
findings.repair_grain: Derive and validate source_candidate_id from the exact candidate replay material/hash.
